# The paths of planning and prose files, read by taskfiles/classify-changes.sh. A change whose
# files are all planning or prose files skips the build and the tests on the forge
# (.github/workflows/check.yml); any other change runs task check.
#
# One line per pattern: "<class> <pattern>". A line that starts with # is a comment; a blank
# line is skipped. The class is one of
#   prose  a planning or prose file;
#   code   a file a gate step, a test or a build reads, even if a prose line matches it too;
#   site   a file of a built site (website/): code, and the classifier also reports site=true.
# A pattern is a shell pattern over the path from the repository root, in which * also matches
# "/" (".engineering/*" is every file under .engineering/). A path that no line matches is
# code, and a path that matches code or site is code whatever prose line matches it. The
# forge reads this file from the base of the change, and a change of this file is code.
#
# A Markdown file a gate step reads as data gets a code line here, with the task that reads it.

prose .engineering/*
prose *.md

# test262-check, test262-moves-check, test262-sources (taskfiles/test262.yml) and site-data
# (taskfiles/site.yml): the swell-slices block and the count table.
code docs/design/engine.md
# host-requirements-check (taskfiles/host-requirements.yml): the HOST-<n> requirements.
code docs/design/host-interface.md
# Files under these directories are read by tests, builds and gate steps (the fixtures
# crates/test262/tests/fixtures/*.md are read by the tests of swell-test262).
code crates/*
code tests/*
code conformance/*
code spec/*
code data/*

site website/*
